notes: SHIP v1.14.351 - DESKTOP SHELL: full-width nav strip + the SECOND fixed strip finally gets paid for. Ships §1 and §2 of design/FIX-DESKTOP-NAV-CARDS.md (web-Claude, written from .342); §3 and §4 are held for a separate ship because recon found §3 largely already shipped by .343. CSS ONLY - no JS, no markup, no data path, no logic. §2 IS THE REAL FIELD DEFECT AND THE RECON CORRECTED ITS DIAGNOSIS: the spec reported 'desktop bottom clipping - cannot scroll the last content clear of the nav'. The cause is not desktop and not the nav. #ph-dock (the MECH/PWR/NET/COMP/VAL phase strip, :9113) is a SECOND position:fixed strip that anchors at bottom:var(--rd-navclear) - i.e. stacked directly above the nav - on rack detail only, gated body.rd.ops-detail.ph-dock-on. Page bottom clearance was body.rd .page{padding-bottom:calc(var(--rd-navclear)+20px)}, which pays for the NAV ONLY. Nothing anywhere in the file added a term for the dock, so on any rack detail the last ~51px of content (LOG NOTE, ASSIGNED TO, the QR button) sat behind the dock at maximum scroll. That is shell-independent - the dock is fixed in both compositions - so the phone had the identical bug and it was only ever reported on desktop. FIX: one rule, body.rd.ops-detail.ph-dock-on .page, adding var(--rd-dockclear) to the existing clearance. Specificity (0,4,1) beats the base (0,2,1), so no !important. It is gated on the exact two body classes that mount the dock, so every other surface - Home, TOOLS, the deploy list, legacy - keeps byte-identical padding and the normal scroll runway does not grow anywhere the dock is not up. NEW TOKEN, AND WHY IT IS LOAD-BEARING RATHER THAN DESCRIPTIVE: --rd-dockclear:51px is declared on body.rd beside --rd-navclear AND consumed by #ph-dock itself as min-height. The dock's height and the clearance that pays for it now read from ONE token and cannot drift apart. This is the .341 lesson applied directly: --tabnav-h sat at 72 while the .339 icon bump grew the real nav to 96, the clearance silently under-paid, and the bug looked like a layout problem rather than a stale constant. A clearance number that merely DESCRIBES a strip goes stale the next time the strip changes and fails silently - there is no error, just content under a bar. 51px is not a guess: global box-sizing is border-box and the dock is 1px border-top + 6px padding + 38px chip min-height + 6px padding, so min-height:51px resolves to the same 38px chip content box the rule already produced - verified zero visual change, the token simply becomes the source. §1 DESKTOP NAV: #rd-botnav was width-capped in three places (base :9430 max-width:760px+margin-inline:auto, the ≥640 rule, the ≥980 rule at 1080px), so on a laptop it rendered as a floating dark box with page content visible either side of it. Released at ≥1024 via max-width:none + margin-inline:0. Equal specificity to the ≥980 rule but later in source, so it wins without !important, and it out-specifies the unscoped base rule. THE SPEC OVER-DESCRIBED THIS ONE: it also asked for an opaque solid-black surface, but .338 already put the solid stat-card gradient on this element - the translucency/blur symptom was already gone, only the width was wrong, so the surface was left untouched rather than re-specified. The icon GROUP deliberately stays 1080 wide and centered (grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,270px)) + justify-content:center) instead of spreading four items across a 2560px monitor: the spec asked for the icons centered as a group, and the four tabs keep exactly the spacing they have today. Only the black surface extends - the strip becomes a floor rather than a raft. Phone and tablet are below the breakpoint and are untouched, per the two-shells rule. HELD OUT OF THIS SHIP, DELIBERATELY: §3 card-surface unification is largely ALREADY DONE - .343 put --rd-cardfill on the assistant card, the s1:001 SWITCH strip (.cc-rackline) and QUICK TOOLS, three of the five surfaces the spec lists as stragglers. Genuinely left are .cc-rackhero (:9220, still a cyan-dim radial over #04060a) and a 'DEVICES section' the spec does not identify - best match is the COMPONENTS card at :35331 carrying an inline background:var(--surf-1), which needs an owner confirm before anything touches it. §3's 'remove per-card background overrides entirely' would also mean sweeping 22 inline background:var(--surf-1) sites inside JS-generated HTML strings, which is a far larger diff than a CSS pass and edits JS while the spec itself says no logic changes. §4 (hero rack trays near-invisible) rides with §3 since it is the same card. Splitting keeps this ship reversible as one cosmetic CSS revert. Gates: inline-JS vm.Script x3, CSS brace net-0, three-stamp .350->.351, CRLF preserved, ?legacy=1 untouched (both rules are body.rd-scoped; the nav element never renders outside body.rd). DEVICE-VERIFY (clear SW first): DESKTOP ≥1024 - nav is one black strip edge to edge with no page content beside it, the four icons still centered as a group at their current spacing. BOTH SHELLS - open a rack detail with the phase strip up, scroll to absolute bottom, and confirm LOG NOTE / ASSIGNED TO / QR clear the strip completely; check the phone too, since that surface had the same bug. Home and TOOLS scroll exactly as before (clearance must NOT have grown there). ROLLBACK: revert this commit - CSS only, nothing else depends on it.
